question: Padma Subramanyam, Alarmel Valli, Yamini Krishnamurthy and Anita Ratnam are distinguished practitioners of __________:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest and most popular classical dance forms of **India**.
 
• It originated in **Tamil Nadu** and has deep roots in ancient temple dances performed as a form of devotion.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive gestures known as **mudras**.
 
• **Padma Subramanyam, Alarmel Valli, Yamini Krishnamurthy, and Anita Ratnam** are renowned practitioners who have made significant contributions to Bharatanatyam.
 
• The dance form is traditionally performed to **Carnatic music** and incorporates storytelling through facial expressions and body movements.
 
• Bharatanatyam is often performed solo and is considered a spiritual offering to the **Hindu gods**, particularly Lord Shiva in his form as **Nataraja**, the cosmic dancer.
 
• This dance form emphasizes rhythm, expression (**abhinaya**), and dramatic storytelling.
 
• The costumes worn during Bharatanatyam performances are colorful and elaborate, often featuring silk sarees, jewelry, and makeup that enhance the dancer's appearance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi**__

 __
 
• **Odissi** is a classical dance form that originated in **Odisha**.
 
• It is known for its **fluid and lyrical movements**, portraying themes of devotion and spirituality.
 
• Odissi has a unique blend of **tribhanga posture** (three bends of the body) and intricate footwork.
 
• The dance is primarily performed to **Odissi music**, which is rich in melody and rhythm.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**__
 __
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form from **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It combines dance, music, and acting, with performers often enacting stories from **Hindu mythology**.
 
• Kuchipudi is distinct for its use of **speech and dialogue** during performances.
 
• The dance form is performed on a brass plate as part of its unique repertoire.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**__
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **North India**.
 
• It emphasizes intricate footwork, spins, and storytelling through rhythmic movements.
 
• Kathak is performed to both **Hindustani classical music** and devotional themes.
 
• The dance form evolved under both **Hindu** and **Mughal** patronage, incorporating elements of Persian culture.
